jobs.occupation: Sales Enablement Lead Hybrids (m/f/d) (Berater/in - Erneuerbare Energien)
jobs.description: ENERCON GmbHAt ENERCON, we are combining wind energy and battery storage into integrated hybrid energy systems. To scale our Wind+Storage business, we are looking for a Sales Enablement Lead who can turn grid-scale BESS expertise into practical sales tools, consistent proposals, and clear contracting standards.Your Mission:As Sales Enablement Lead Hybrids (m/f/d), you will be the primary interface within the Solution Line Hybrids for the Head of Technical Sales, who has overall responsibility for Wind+Storage sales. Together, you will establish the sales process from opportunity qualification and initial BESS sizing through proposal development and contracting. You will build the tools and standards that support this process and define a structured handover from Sales to Project Management.You will work closely with the Global Growth Lead within the Solution Line Hybrids to match pipeline projects with suitable contractors and suppliers. While the Global Growth Lead acts as the primary interface to Global Procurement, you will bring customer requirements and proposed offer commitments into the matching process. Together, you will ensure that what ENERCON offers customers aligns with what Global Procurement can source and suppliers can deliver.Your Responsibilities:- Establish and continuously improve the Wind+Storage sales process together with the Head of Technical Sales, defining clear roles, review steps, and deliverables from opportunity qualification through contracting.- Build and maintain technical sales tools for preliminary BESS sizing and configuration, proposal development, and documentation of assumptions and scope boundaries.- Develop standard contract templates and technical schedules with the Head of Technical Sales, Legal, and Engineering, covering scope, performance guarantees, acceptance criteria, and Divisions of Responsibility (DoRs).- Equip regional wind sales teams to qualify and develop standard Wind+Storage opportunities through practical training, playbooks, qualification checklists, and reusable proposal materials.- Define clear criteria with the Head of Technical Sales for when regional teams can proceed independently and when specialist input is needed. Support complex opportunities that require expert review of BESS configurations, customer requirements, or proposed contract commitments.- Partner with the Global Growth Lead on project-to-supplier matching. Bring customer requirements, sizing assumptions, and proposed contract commitments into the assessment so that offers reflect the scope, interfaces, performance, and delivery timelines suppliers can commit to.- Define a structured handover to Project Management so that the agreed technical scope, contractual commitments, assumptions, interfaces, and open risks are documented and transferred at contract award.- Use feedback from regional teams, bids, negotiations, and project handovers to improve sales processes, tools, and contracting standards.Your Profile:- Several years of hands-on experience with grid-scale BESS, including technical sizing and configuration for customer projects. You understand how use cases, grid connection limits, and operating requirements translate into power and energy ratings and performance requirements.- Practical experience in technical sales and contracting for grid-scale BESS projects, including proposal development, scope definition, and negotiation of technical or commercial contract terms.- Familiarity with BESS performance guarantees, acceptance criteria, and Divisions of Responsibility (DoRs), and the ability to translate technical assumptions into clear offer and contract language.- University degree in Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Business Engineering, Renewable Energy, or a comparable field.- Experience building repeatable sales processes, technical sales tools, or standard proposal and contract documentation for complex energy or infrastructure projects.- Experience equipping regional sales teams to sell complex technical solutions, for example through training, practical tools, or coaching on customer opportunities.- Ability to work across Sales, Engineering, Procurement, Legal, and Project Management, and to explain technical trade-offs clearly to customers and internal stakeholders.- Fluent in English; German language skills are an advantage.- Willingness to travel internationally.What Makes This Role Special:You will shape how ENERCON sizes, offers, and contracts Wind+Storage projects. Working alongside the Head of Technical Sales, you will build a sales process that regional wind sales teams can use across markets, giving them more ownership of standard opportunities while allowing Technical Sales to focus its expertise where it adds the most value.By bringing supplier capabilities into the offer process early and making customer commitments clear at handover, you will help ensure that what Sales promises, Procurement sources, and Project Management delivers fit together.Why ENERCON?- Shape the future of renewable energy through innovative Wind+Storage solutions.- Work in a highly international and collaborative environment.- Take ownership of a strategically important global function with high visibility across the organization.- Contribute directly to the growth of sustainable energy systems and the global energy transition.- Join a company with decades of experience and technological leadership in renewable energy.Ready to shape how ENERCON sells and contracts Wind+Storage solutions? We look forward to receiving your application.

jobs.occupation: Global Growth Lead Hybrids (m/f/d) (Berater/in - Erneuerbare Energien)
jobs.description: ENERCON GmbHInnovative ideas are the foundation of our success. At ENERCON, we are driving the energy transition by combining wind energy and battery storage solutions into scalable, sustainable hybrid power systems. Join us in shaping the next generation of renewable energy solutions and supporting customers worldwide on their path to a carbon-neutral future.Your Mission:As Global Growth Lead Hybrids (m/f/d), you will be the primary interface between the Solution Line Hybrids and Global Procurement. Your immediate priority is to match projects in our Wind+Storage pipeline with suitable contractors and system integrators. You will work closely with the Sales Enablement Lead within the Solution Line Hybrids to create a back-to-back process between BESS sales and procurement. Together with Global Procurement, Engineering, and Project Delivery, you will translate project requirements into supplier needs and assess which partners can deliver the required scope.Over the medium term, you will help prepare ENERCON's hybrid business for expansion into new markets. You will assess market attractiveness, work with regional teams on go-to-market plans, and apply lessons from Germany to adapt our supplier setup and delivery model to local conditions.Your Responsibilities:- Act as the primary point of contact for Global Procurement within the Solution Line Hybrids, translating pipeline demand into clear supplier requirements and priorities.- Partner closely with the Sales Enablement Lead to match pipeline projects with suitable BESS EPC contractors and system integrators, ensuring that customer offers reflect the scope, responsibilities, and delivery timelines that suppliers can commit to.- Work with Global Procurement and technical teams to evaluate BESS EPC contractors and system integrators, assessing relevant project references, technical capabilities, scope coverage, and delivery capability.- Collaborate with Engineering and Project Delivery to define and review Divisions of Responsibility (DoRs) across the BESS scope, electrical balance of plant (eBoP), and civil balance of plant (cBoP), identifying scope gaps, overlaps, and interface risks.- Maintain a clear view of upcoming project needs, supplier readiness, and gaps in supplier coverage to support procurement planning and project decisions.- Assess the attractiveness of future markets for Wind+Storage, considering customer demand, market conditions, routes to market, and local supplier and delivery capabilities.- Develop go-to-market plans with regional teams and coordinate market-entry preparations, including identifying local partners and assessing what is needed to deliver the first projects.- Capture lessons from German projects and adapt proven approaches to supplier evaluation, scope definition, and project delivery for new markets.Your Profile:- Several years of hands-on experience with grid-scale BESS projects, ideally in supplier selection, project development, contracting, or delivery.- University degree in Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Business Engineering, Renewable Energy, or a comparable field.- Experience evaluating BESS EPC contractors and system integrators is a strong advantage, particularly in assessing technical and commercial fit, project references, and delivery capability.- Deep understanding of electrical and civil balance of plant (eBoP and cBoP) and practical experience working with Divisions of Responsibility (DoRs) to define scope boundaries and interfaces.- Experience with market assessment, go-to-market planning, or market entry in the energy or infrastructure sector is an advantage.- Experience working across procurement, engineering, sales, and project delivery, ideally in an international environment.- Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to turn technical and commercial assessments into clear recommendations.- Fluent in English; German language skills are an advantage.- Willingness to travel internationally.What Makes This Role SpecialYou will help determine which partners ENERCON works with to deliver Wind+Storage projects and how responsibilities are shared. By bringing Sales Enablement and Global Procurement together early, you will help ensure that what ENERCON commits to customers is backed by what its suppliers can deliver.As the business expands, you will use lessons from projects in Germany to shape how ENERCON enters new markets. You will help regional teams decide where to grow, which local partners are needed, and what must be in place to deliver the first projects.Why ENERCON?- Be part of one of the world's leading renewable energy technology companies.- Shape the future of hybrid renewable energy systems combining wind power and battery storage.- Work in an international and highly innovative environment.- Contribute directly to the global energy transition.- Take on a strategically important role with high visibility and significant impact.Ready to connect the right partners with the right projects and help scale Wind+Storage globally? We look forward to receiving your application.

jobs.occupation: Clinical Protocol Standards  & Medical Writing Governance (all genders) (Medical Writer)
jobs.description: Work Your Magic with us!Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.United As One for Patients, our purpose in Healthcare is to help create, improve and prolong lives. We develop medicines, intelligent devices and innovative technologies in therapeutic areas such as Oncology, Neurology and Fertility. Our teams work together across 6 continents with passion and relentless curiosity in order to help patients at every stage of life. Joining our Healthcare team is becoming part of a diverse, inclusive and flexible working culture, presenting great opportunities for personal development and career advancement across the globe.Your Role:Clinical protocols are the backbone of every study, and the standards behind them shape how efficiently and compliantly a global development portfolio operates. In this senior individual contributor role, you will own and continuously evolve global protocol templates, reusable content, and governance processes that enable study teams to author high quality protocols at scale.You will lead a cross functional Protocol Standards Governance Team spanning Medical Writing, Clinical Development, Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Regulatory Affairs, Patient Safety, and Quality, resolving competing requirements and driving timely decisions. You will advance structured, component based authoring and automation, govern changes driven by evolving standards such as ICH M11, and mentor colleagues while leading training and change management for new standards.Who You Are:• Degree in life sciences, pharmacy, medicine, or a related scientific discipline, or equivalent professional experience• Typically 6 or more years of relevant experience in clinical development, for example in Medical Writing, Clinical Development, Clinical Operations, or a related function• Substantial hands on experience authoring, leading, or critically reviewing clinical study protocols and amendments• Proven ability to translate complex scientific, regulatory, or operational requirements into clear, practical standards, guidance, or processes• Experience developing or governing protocol templates, clinical document standards, or reusable content, including structured, technology-enabled, component-based authoring or ICH M11 related initiatives• Strong working knowledge of ICH guidelines and GCP requirements as they apply to clinical study protocols• Demonstrated ability to lead complex cross functional initiatives, working groups, or governance activities, resolving competing requirements and driving decisions without direct authority• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with strong facilitation and stakeholder management capabilitiesLocation: Darmstadt, Germany | HybridWhat we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

jobs.employer_name: BIPS Institut f. Epidemiologie u.Präventionsforschg GmbH
jobs.description: Job announcementThe Leibniz Institute for Prevention Research and Epidemiology – BIPS GmbH invites applications for several positions (depending upon funding) to be filled asPhD in prevention research (m/f/d/x)Salary scale 13 TV-L (70% position).Starting from January 1, 2027 or later for the duration of 3 years (extension possible).In the coming years, the Leibniz Institute for Prevention Research and Epidemiology – BIPS will expand its research into the prevention of chronic, non-communicable diseases across the life course. The focus is on factors beyond individual diseases, such as lifestyle and environment, digital media, biological and social factors, as well as early detection. Existing large cohort studies based on primary data based will be used (e.g., IDEFICS/I.Family cohort study, NAKO Health Study), a birth cohort will be established and secondary data (health claims data) will be analyzed. Further, implementation and interventional research will be conducted to develop and evaluate innovative strategies for targeted prevention. The research is cross-departmental and involves all scientific departments of BIPS.In this context, we are looking for several PhD students with interest in at least one of the following areas:• Epidemiology with a focus on primary data• Epidemiological research based on health claims data• Implementation science• Health decision scienceTasks:• Coordinate and participate in research projects• Data analysis and interpretation of results• Publish and present research results• Support reporting of resultsRequirements:• Master’s degree (or equivalent including ‘Staatsexamen’) in one of the areas mentioned above or related disciplines• Good command of spoken and written English• Strong interest in interdisciplinary research• Initiative, motivation, commitment, and scientific curiosityWhat we offer:The Leibniz Institute for Prevention Research and Epidemiology – BIPS offers exciting research topics, a stimulating international environment, a good infrastructure, close ties to the University of Bremen and an engaged, supportive and cooperative team. Postdocs are encouraged to strive for scientific independence and to establish their own research focus. BIPS holds the audit ‘berufundfamilie’ (work and family) certificate and actively promotes the compatibility of career and individual lifestyle through flexible working hours, mobile working options, and continuous professional development. We also offer additional support for international scholars to relocate to Germany through the Welcome Center of the U Bremen Research Alliance.Among equally qualified applicants, preference will be given to severely disabled candidates.Enquiries to: Dr. Wiebke Schäfer, phone: +49 421 218 56 887Additional information can be found on our homepage: https://www.leibniz-bips.de/en.Please send your application in English or German including a cover letter, CV and certificates quoting the reference number A26-33 and mention at least of one of the topics above by November 27, 2026 by e-mail as a single PDF file to:bewerbung@leibniz-bips.dePlease note that applications which do not comply with the required format (1 PDF document) cannot be considered.For information on salaries, please refer to the TV-L salary calculator for 2026; the position is classified under pay grade E13 of the TV-L. Salary calculator: https://oeffentlicher-dienst.info/c/t/rechner/tv-l/allg?id=tv-l-2026Leibniz Institute for Prevention Research and Epidemiology – BIPS GmbH Human Resources Department Achterstr. 30 28359 Bremen GermanyErgänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Evaluation, Gesundheitsvorsorge (Prävention)
